changelog: Protected dashboard requests now wait until the portal has validated the session, preventing an empty Overview immediately after sign-in.
First login with a required password change hydrates the active view without requiring a search or a manual Refresh click.
changelog_es: Overview now waits for a valid authenticated session before requesting protected dashboard data, preventing an empty initial view after sign-in.
First login with a required password change now hydrates the active view without requiring a manual search or Refresh click.
Session restoration and logout share an idempotent authentication gate so each session performs one initial view load and protected polling stops when authentic
